```{python}
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

ROOT = Path.cwd()
while not (ROOT / "results").exists() and ROOT != ROOT.parent:
    ROOT = ROOT.parent
M = json.loads((ROOT / "results" / "model_matrix" / "matrix.json").read_text())
FIGDIR = "model-matrix"

MODELS = list(M["models"])
CATS = {
    "A": "A · real cruise",
    "B": "B · matched-RPS synthetic",
    "C": "C · stream trajectories, rig fits",
    "D": "D · stream trajectories, hard cloud",
}
LABEL = {
    "hppnet-real-best": "HPPNet L2, real-best (gating)",
    "hppnet-easy": "HPPNet L2, easy cloud",
    "scv2-real-R4": "SCv2, real R4",
    "scv2-hard": "SCv2, hard cloud",
}
clips = {c["key"]: c for c in M["clips"]}
```

## What this is

Four trained models are run on 24 clips. The clips come from four
distributions. Every score is a per-clip PIT MAE in rev/s, with **one rotor
assignment per clip** — the convention `losses.pit.pit_mse_loss` and
`metrics.rps.batched_pit_mae` both use, so these numbers are comparable with
every other rotor-speed result in the project.

| category | what it is |
|:--|:--|
| **A** | 6 real cruise clips of the frozen split: 3 Michael FLY124, 3 DREGON room 1 |
| **B** | the same 6 RPS tracks, re-rendered from the matching rig's fitted model |
| **C** | 6 RPS trajectories from the training stream's own generator, rendered from the rig fits (3 Michael, 3 DREGON) |
| **D** | the same 6 trajectories, each rendered from a random hard-cloud parameter draw |

## Summary

```{python}
for stat in ("mean", "median"):
    rows = []
    for m in MODELS:
        row = {"model": LABEL[m]}
        for cat in CATS:
            agg = M["aggregates"][m][cat]
            for part, name in (("michaels", "mich"), ("dregon", "dreg"), ("all", "all")):
                row[f"{cat} {name}"] = round(agg[part][stat], 2)
        rows.append(row)
    display(Markdown(f"**{stat.capitalize()} over clips — PIT MAE (rev/s), mic 0**"))
    display(pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("model"))
```

`mich` / `dreg` is the rig the clip belongs to: the recording for **A**, the rig
fit that rendered it for **B** and **C**. For **D** it is the trajectory half
whose **C** twin used that fit — a **D** clip's own parameters are a hard-cloud
draw, not a rig.

## Where a mean hides a failure

```{python}
display(Markdown("\n".join(f"- {w.strip()}" for w in M["warnings"])))
```

## Per clip

```{python}
rows = []
for key, c in clips.items():
    row = {"clip": key, "category": c["category"], "rig": c["rig"]}
    row.update({LABEL[m]: round(v, 2) for m, v in c["pit_mae"].items()})
    rows.append(row)
df = pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("clip")
display(df)
```

## Figures

Each figure: the clip spectrogram on top, then the regime strip, then the rotor
speeds. Target tracks are thick and light. Each model's **four raw output
series** are drawn thin over them — no matching, no permutation, so a line may
sit near a target that is not its own rotor. That is what the model emits.

```{python}
order = ["A", "B", "C", "D"]
for cat in order:
    display(Markdown(f"### {CATS[cat]}"))
    for key, c in clips.items():
        if c["category"] != cat:
            continue
        scores = "  ·  ".join(f"{LABEL[m]} **{v:.2f}**" for m, v in c["pit_mae"].items())
        display(Markdown(f"**{key}** — {c['recording']}\n\n{scores}\n\n![]({FIGDIR}/{key}.png)\n"))
```

## Provenance

```{python}
prov = {
    "git HEAD": M["git_head"],
    "metric": M["metric"] if isinstance(M["metric"], str) else json.dumps(M["metric"]),
    "split": f"{M['clip_set']['split']} @ {M['clip_set']['split_version']}",
    "clips": M["clip_set"]["n_clips"],
    "duration_s": M["clip_set"]["duration_s"],
    "mics rendered": M["clip_set"]["n_mics_rendered"],
}
display(pd.DataFrame(prov.items(), columns=["field", "value"]).set_index("field"))
display(Markdown("**Checkpoints**"))
ck = [
    {
        "model": LABEL[m],
        "experiment": v["experiment"],
        "checkpoint": v["ckpt"],
        "sha256": v["digest"].removeprefix("sha256:")[:16],
        "salience decoder": v["salience_decoder"],
    }
    for m, v in M["models"].items()
]
display(pd.DataFrame(ck).set_index("model"))
```

Full per-clip provenance — render seeds, anchor fit digests, hard-cloud entry
indices and their mixing coordinates — is in
`results/model_matrix/matrix.json`. Rebuild everything with
`PYTHONPATH="$PWD/src:$PWD/scripts" python scripts/_model_matrix.py`.
